updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Expansion: Safeguard Sensitive Data in Copilot Web Searches
updates.summary: Microsoft is extending Data Loss Prevention controls to prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from performing external web searches when prompts or search queries contain sensitive data. This real-time protection reduces the risk of accidental data leakage through AI-assisted tools, helping organizations maintain compliance when employees use Copilot for work tasks.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP for Copilot: Government Cloud Support for Prompt Protection
updates.summary: DLP protections for Microsoft 365 Copilot are now rolling out to government cloud environments, preventing Copilot from responding to or grounding queries that contain sensitive data. This extends data leakage safeguards to highly regulated sectors relying on government cloud deployments.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62825: Azure Key Vault Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper authentication flaw in Azure Key Vault allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network, potentially compromising secret and key management. Admins managing identity and access control must apply security updates to prevent unauthorized access to cryptographic keys and credentials.

updates.title: CVE-2026-56191: Microsoft Exchange Online Tampering Vulnerability
updates.summary: Improper authentication in Exchange Online permits unauthorized attackers to tamper with content over a network. This vulnerability could allow attackers to modify messages, settings, or security configurations without proper credentials, requiring immediate security patching.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62835: Online Services Information Disclosure Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper authorization vulnerability in Online Services allows attackers to disclose sensitive information over the network. Organizations should apply patches to prevent unauthorized access to confidential data stored in Microsoft 365 services.

updates.title: CVE-2026-58275: Azure DNS Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Missing authorization controls in Azure DNS enable unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. This could allow attackers to manipulate DNS resolution and potentially intercept or redirect traffic, impacting network security posture.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
updates.summary: Organizations can now apply sensitivity labels directly to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups using the same labels configured for Microsoft 365 groups and sites. This extends data classification and governance to identity objects, enabling unified protection across groups, teams, and security configurations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scale Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive is increasing from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day, allowing organizations to classify and protect more data at rest faster. This enhancement helps close data labeling gaps and prepares larger data estates for compliance and AI integration.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new out-of-box dashboard provides visibility into DLP alert SLA metrics including Mean Time to Acknowledge, Detect, and Respond, with configurable severity thresholds. Compliance teams can now track operational performance and identify top exposed sensitive information types to prioritize remediation efforts.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Rule-Based Alert Tagging and Auto-Resolution
updates.summary: Administrators can now define rules to automatically resolve predictable DLP alerts and apply tags for routing and categorization, reducing triage overhead. For example, low-severity mail alerts to trusted domains can auto-resolve, while alerts from specific departments can be auto-tagged for workflow routing.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Enriched Audit Data for Matched Rules
updates.summary: DLP audit records in Exchange Online now include enriched metadata such as sender domain, subject keywords, attachment type, and recipient information alongside Sensitive Information Type matches. This additional data visibility in alerts and Activity Explorer enables faster incident investigation and more accurate policy tuning.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Graph API access to Exchange Online archive mailboxes (Main and Auxiliary) is now available, providing a unified API surface as legacy EWS APIs retire in October 2026. This enables developers and admins to programmatically manage archival and retention policies across distributed archive infrastructure.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Unified Alert Experience
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now combines the Triage Agent and Standard alert dashboards into a single alerts list, allowing analysts to view and manage both classic and AI-triaged alerts in one location with inline previews. This streamlined interface reduces context switching and accelerates alert investigation workflows.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Expanded User Profile Details from Microsoft Entra
updates.summary: The unified alert experience now displays additional Microsoft Entra identity signals including office location, employee type, department, and last working date to investigators. These enriched user context attributes help security teams correlate insider risk alerts with organizational role and employment status for more accurate risk assessment.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Network Data Security Integration with Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, blocking sensitive data from reaching untrusted cloud apps. This network-layer enforcement prevents data exfiltration through browsers, APIs, and generative AI platforms, complementing endpoint-level controls.

updates.title: CVE-2026-56163: Azure Kubernetes Service Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Missing authentication for a critical function in Azure Kubernetes Service allows unauthorized remote attackers to elevate privileges. Organizations managing Kubernetes workloads in Azure must apply security updates to prevent unauthorized cluster access and privilege escalation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-56160: Azure Red Hat OpenShift Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Improper authorization in Azure Red Hat OpenShift allows an authorized attacker to escalate privileges over the network. Admins running ARO clusters should apply security patches to prevent lateral privilege escalation by already-authenticated users.
